title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 116
paragraphs: While the Persians were sailing around Sunion, the Athenians hurried back to the city at top speed to defend it, and they arrived before the barbarians got there. Having come from the shrine of Heracles at Marathon, they encamped at another shrine of Heracles — the one at Cynosarges. The barbarians, for their part, came and lay with their ships at anchor in the sea off Phalerum (which was then the port of Athens), and after riding there for some time, they sailed back to Asia.
